calibrate.title: Blind Tilt calibration
calibrate.description:
Calibration state of the blind: {state}  (✅ calibrated · ❌ not calibrated · ❓ unknown).

⚠️ Starting ERASES the current calibration and it cannot be restored. There is no cancel: once started, the calibration must be completed (4 steps). If something goes wrong, simply start over from the beginning.

You will turn the rod by hand through 4 steps: closed down, open, closed up, open. Press the button when you are in front of the blind.

ℹ️ As long as a blind is not calibrated, Home Assistant refuses its open/close/position commands.

reprise.title: Calibration in progress
reprise.description: A calibration is already in progress on this blind.

etape_1.title: Step 1 of 4 – closed down
etape_1.description:
Turn the rod, in one direction only, until the blind is FULLY CLOSED DOWN. Stop turning, then press Next.

If the blind is not ready yet, a message tells you what to do. Nothing is saved until it is ready.

etape_2.title: Step 2 of 4 – open
etape_2.description:
Turn the rod, in one direction only, until the blind is FULLY OPEN (flat). Stop turning, then press Next.

If the blind is not ready yet, a message tells you what to do. Nothing is saved until it is ready.

etape_3.title: Step 3 of 4 – closed up
etape_3.description:
Turn the rod the OPPOSITE way to step 1, in one direction only, until the blind is FULLY CLOSED UP. Stop turning, then press Next.

If the blind is not ready yet, a message tells you what to do. Nothing is saved until it is ready.

etape_4.title: Step 4 of 4 – open (last step)
etape_4.description:
Turn the rod, in one direction only, until the blind is FULLY OPEN (flat). Stop turning, then press Finish.

The calibration ends and the blind is checked. If the blind is not ready yet, a message tells you what to do.

abort.calibration_done: ✅ Calibration complete: the blind reports itself calibrated.
abort.calibration_failed: The calibration failed ({detail}). The blind may stay UNCALIBRATED: start over from the beginning.
abort.calibration_failed_timeout: The blind did not answer in time ({detail}). Check the Bluetooth signal, then start over from the beginning. The blind may stay UNCALIBRATED.
abort.calibration_failed_comm: Communication error with the blind ({detail}). Start over from the beginning. The blind may stay UNCALIBRATED.
abort.calibration_failed_refused: The blind refused a calibration command ({detail}). Start over from the beginning. The blind may stay UNCALIBRATED.
abort.calibration_failed_stop_unconfirmed: The blind did not confirm the end of the calibration ({detail}). Check its state, then start over from the beginning.
abort.calibration_failed_not_calibrated: The calibration ended but the blind does not report itself calibrated. Start over from the beginning.
abort.calibration_unavailable: The blind is not available for calibration (integration not loaded).

error.not_ready: The blind is not ready yet. Finish turning the rod, stop, then press the button again.
error.direction_error: ⚠️ The blind reports a direction error: turn the rod the other way, then press the button again.
error.not_at_step: The blind has not moved on to this step yet. Wait a couple of seconds, then press the button again.
error.save_failed: The position could not be saved ({detail}). Press the button again; if it keeps failing, close this window and start over.

calibration_start.name: Start Blind Tilt calibration
calibration_start.description: Starts the calibration of a Blind Tilt and the status stream. Then turn the rod by hand and save each position.

calibration_save.name: Save calibration position
calibration_save.description: Saves the position of the current calibration step. Refused if the blind is not ready or reports a direction error.

calibration_finish.name: Finish Blind Tilt calibration
calibration_finish.description: Ends the calibration. The blind stays uncalibrated unless all 4 positions were saved.

calibration_abort.name: Abort Blind Tilt calibration
calibration_abort.description: Abandons the calibration. The blind stays UNCALIBRATED until a full calibration is redone.

calibration_status.name: Blind Tilt calibration status
calibration_status.description: Returns the current calibration step, readiness, direction error and position counter.

blind_tilt_uncalibrated.title: Blind not calibrated: {name}
blind_tilt_uncalibrated.description:
The SwitchBot blind “{name}” is not calibrated. Until it is, its open, close and position commands are DISABLED in Home Assistant (percentages would be unreliable and movements risky), so automations that command it will fail.

To fix: Settings > Devices & services > SwitchBot > {name} > Configure > Calibrate the blind, then follow the 4 steps.
